manage.title: Stream setups
manage.description: Reusable local preparations for a kind of show - which destinations to enable and which metadata preset to apply. Applying a setup never starts a stream or publishes anything.
manage.emptyDescription: Save your current destinations as a setup, or create one from scratch, to reuse it next time.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this setup?
deleteDialog.message: "{{setup}}" will be removed. Your destinations and their current metadata are not changed - deleting a setup only removes this saved configuration.

form.description: Choose which destinations this setup enables and, optionally, a metadata preset to apply with it.
form.noDestinations: Add a destination first to include it in a setup.

saveCurrent.title: Save current setup
saveCurrent.description: Captures your currently enabled destinations into a new named setup.

fields.noteHint: Optional. A short reminder of what this setup is for.
fields.presetHint: Optional. Applying this setup will also apply the preset's stream details to these destinations.

apply.title: Apply "{{setup}}"
apply.description: Review what will change, then confirm. This only changes local configuration - it never starts a stream or publishes anything.
apply.blocked: Stop streaming on the affected destination(s) before changing this setup.
apply.presetMissing: The metadata preset this setup referenced has been deleted. Destination membership can still be applied; no metadata will be changed.
